import csv
import json

input_path = "data/items.csv"
output_path = "/var/folders/p7/f5mb4g5s27s07fp7n8jstvp00000gn/T/vibe-scratchpad-0bbb2ba5-6fwn2mj9/transformed/items_transformed.csv"

with open(input_path, mode='r') as infile, open(output_path, mode='w', newline='') as outfile:
    reader = csv.DictReader(infile)
    writer = csv.writer(outfile)
    writer.writerow(["item_id", "embedding", "label"])
    
    for row in reader:
        embedding = json.loads(row["embedding"])
        embedding_str = ",".join(map(str, embedding))
        writer.writerow([row["item_id"], embedding_str, row["label"]])
